messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: GPU queue length exceeded threshold in prod-eu-1. metric: gpu.request_queue_size > 1200 for 6m. Autoscaler errors: "Unable to create nodes: launchtemplate mismatch / instance profile denied". Alert: https://dash.redwood.ai/alerts/1382
anya (oncall-ml): seeing big growth on inference queue, latency spiking to 800ms p50, 2.3s p95. Customers hitting streaming stalls.
aseem (infra): checking autoscaler logs now, grabbing ASG + LT info.
mike (eng-sre): adding myself, will help coordinate manual actions and rollback plan.
elaine (support): I'm fielding customer slack tickets — several customers reporting timeouts on generation endpoints (not embeddings). Trying to triage severity levels.
k8s-bot: Event stream (last 5m):
```
Warning  FailedCreate  2m  cluster-autoscaler  Error creating: InstanceLaunchBlocked: Launch template version 9 references iam instance profile "gpu-role-v2" which does not exist in this account
Warning  FailedCreate  2m  cluster-autoscaler  Tainted: unable to apply taint to new node: missing permissions
```
anya (oncall-ml): that IAM profile mismatch is new? we rolled LT v9 yesterday for kernel bump.
aseem (infra): the new launch template used an instance profile name from staging by mistake. Confirmed: LT v9 has profile gpu-role-staging. autoscaler is trying to scale but EC2 API blocks.
mike (eng-sre): ok that explains create failures. Immediate mitigation options: 1) revert autoscaler to use LT v8, 2) patch LT v9 to correct profile, 3) manually spin up spare nodes and add them to cluster (quickest). Thoughts?
anya (oncall-ml): prefer manual spin up + patch LT so autoscaler can resume. we need capacity now.
aseem (infra): I'll request a temporary ASG desired capacity bump for gpu-pool-eu-1 and launch 4 on-demand g5 instances manually with LT v8. Giving me 10m.
elaine (support): can we throttle low-priority batch jobs meanwhile? that'll free some GPU for streaming customers.
mike (eng-sre): yes, we can evict low-priority batch pods. I'll run a graceful eviction script to drain batch-queue namespace pods with disruption budget fallback.
anya (oncall-ml): do it but maintain one replica for critical jobs.
mike (eng-sre): running:
```
kubectl get pods -n batch-queue -l job=low-priority -o name | xargs -r -n1 kubectl delete pod --grace-period=30 -n batch-queue
```
(reacts :thumbsup:)
aseem (infra): manual instance launches requested with AWS console, referencing LT v8. I also opened a ticket with infra-automation to patch LT v9 to point to gpu-role-prod. Ticket #INF-4823. ETA ~25m for automation patch.
k8s-bot: Autoscaler logs tail:
```
I0328 12:06:10 cluster-autoscaler: Failed to create node: InvalidInstanceProfile: The instance profile 'gpu-role-staging' does not exist
I0328 12:06:11 cluster-autoscaler: Maximum node group size reached for gpu-pool-eu-1 (10/10)
```
mike (eng-sre): interesting — autoscaler also hit ASG max. Even if LT fixed we might be capped. Can we temporarily raise the ASG max to 15?
aseem (infra): I can if we have approval. Increasing max to 15 for gpu-pool-eu-1 now. Change applied.
anya (oncall-ml): how's queue length now after evictions and manual instances?
mike (eng-sre): queue dropped from 1300 -> 420 in 8 minutes after evicting ~28 low-priority pods and adding 3 manual nodes. p95 latency down to 1.1s.
elaine (support): telling impacted customers we have partial mitigation, services degrading but recovering. CS ticket updated.
aseem (infra): LT v9 patch submitted to infra-automation, but we'll also update instance profile alias to gpu-role-prod manually as immediate fallback. Patching LT v9 now.
k8s-bot: New events:
```
Normal  SuccessfulCreate  3m  autoscaler  Created 3 new nodes (i-0abc..., i-0def..., i-0ghi...)
Normal  NodeReady  2m  kubelet    Node i-0abc becomes Ready
```
anya (oncall-ml): traffic looks stable-ish. We should monitor for 30m then demote this from P1 if no regression.
mike (eng-sre): next steps: 1) revert LT rollout to avoid future mismatches, 2) add CI check on launch template instance profile existence, 3) raise ASG soft limit doc for emergencies. I'll file follow-ups.
aseem (infra): ASG max bumped back to 12 now that autoscaler can create. We'll scale down manual nodes once cluster stabilizes.
elaine (support): customers 2245, 2278, and 2290 reported interruptions — marked Sev2. Noting RM: possible SLA hit for 2245 (enterprise). Assigning to AM team for postmortem outreach.
anya (oncall-ml): can we add a temporary routing policy to route new long-running generation requests to dedicated capacity region (prod-us-west) for affected customers? Might reduce queue.
mike (eng-sre): config change possible but risky. Instead let's enable request admission control to reject very large generation jobs >60s for a short window. I'll toggle admission flag.
mike (eng-sre): toggled: set /config/admission/allow_long_runs=false (will auto revert in 2h).
k8s-bot: Autoscaler resumed normal ops; creating 2 nodes to replenish after evictions.
anya (oncall-ml): monitoring metrics: queue at 210, p95 0.9s. Good.
aseem (infra): LT v9 now points to gpu-role-prod and IAM policies validated. Automation PR merged: infra/launch-templates#789.
mike (eng-sre): post-incident TODOs assigned: - add LT verification CI (owner: aseem) - add ASG escalation playbook (owner: mike) - admission fallback policy doc (owner: anya)
elaine (support): CS outreach scheduled for 1500 UTC.
anya (oncall-ml): wrapping — demoting pager to monitored. Will leave this thread open till 13:00 UTC for any recurrences. Thanks all. :heart:
incident-bot: Incident stamped: GPU-Autoscale-2187654321 - mitigated at 2026-03-28T12:45:30Z
